findings.passage: “In Ohio, it’s already the law that when you vote in person, you need to show that photo ID," Ferguson said in an interview. findings.note: Statehouse News Bureau interview about his HB 577. He says in-person voting already needs photo ID and the bill extends that to mail ballots.
